items.author: justinbuist.bsky.social
items.context: Doom was the first PC game I remember other kids being excited about when they first saw it.
items.text: Doom was a moment. The shareware episode spread so widely that a lot of kids saw it before anyone else did.

items.author: misteraustin.bsky.social
items.context:
while looking for the box art, I found a webpage with the header "Is King's Quest III: To Heir Is Human Down Right Now?" and I'm pleased to report that no: the server for this mid-80s DOS game is fully operational, thank god
image: screenshot of a webpage that says "King's Quest III: To Heir is Human Server Status: No problems detected." it says "Last check: 16S ago" so someone is on top …
items.text: Glad to hear King's Quest III is still holding up. Thank god indeed.
